definitions.explanation: The oldest daughter in a family. Used in formal contexts such as family registers, introductions, and official documents.

examples.japanese: ⟦{私|わたし}→私：02988_watashi⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{三人|さんにん}→三人：10978_sannin⟧⟦{姉妹|しまい}→姉妹：03201_shimai⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{長女|ちょうじょ}です。
examples.english: I am the eldest daughter of three sisters.

examples.japanese: {長女|ちょうじょ}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{今年|ことし}→今年：00722_kotoshi⟧⟦{小学校|しょうがっこう}→小学校：01055_shougakkou⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{入学|にゅうがく}する→入学する：01851_nyuugakusuru⟧。
examples.english: Our eldest daughter starts elementary school this year.

examples.japanese: {長女|ちょうじょ}⟦として→として：06802_toshite⟧⟦{家族|かぞく}→家族：00552_kazoku⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{面倒|めんどう}を{見|み}る→面倒を見る：18263_mendouwomiru⟧⟦{責任|せきにん}→責任：03298_sekinin⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{感|かん}じていた→感じる：02044_kanjiru⟧。
examples.english: As the eldest daughter, she felt a responsibility to take care of the family.

notes:
Compound of {長|ちょう} (eldest/senior) + {女|じょ} (daughter/female).

Birth order terms in Japanese:
- {長女|ちょうじょ} (eldest daughter), ⟦{次女|じじょ}→次女：15831_jijo⟧ (second daughter), ⟦{三女|さんじょ}→三女：10690_sanjo⟧ (third daughter)
- ⟦{長男|ちょうなん}→長男：14519_chounan⟧ (eldest son), ⟦{次男|じなん}→次男：13210_jinan⟧ (second son), ⟦{三男|さんなん}→三男：10689_sannan⟧ (third son)

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {長女|ちょうじょ}⟦として→として：06802_toshite⟧ (as the eldest daughter)
- {長女|ちょうじょ}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{生|う}まれる→生まれる：00905_umareru⟧ (the first daughter is born)

USAGE:
In conversation, people often say ⟦{上|うえ}→上：00682_ue⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{娘|むすめ}→娘：02263_musume⟧ (older daughter) or {一番上|いちばんうえ}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{娘|むすめ}→娘：02263_musume⟧ instead. {長女|ちょうじょ} sounds more formal.
